purpose: This table provides cleaned hourly ASOS weather observations at the three NYC airports (EWR, JFK, LGA) for January through June 2013, intended to join against flight data on origin and time to support weather-aware flight analyses.
usage: Join on origin and time_hour to align with flight records; wind_dir, wind_speed, pressure, and especially wind_gust (74.6% null) may be null and must be handled explicitly rather than assumed zero, and the unusually high wind_speed max (1048.36058 mph) should be treated with caution pending investigation.
limitations: Pipeline metadata columns were dropped entirely; wind_gust is missing in nearly three-quarters of rows and pressure in about 11.5%, limiting their reliability for aggregate analysis; the wind_speed column contains at least one implausible maximum value that was not resolved in this cleanup.
